title: Remove empty ASN.1 dissector headers
description:
A number of ASN.1 dissectors have empty headers that don't export
anything and have the exports commented out (as a placeholder, perhaps.)
Remove them.

commits_data.title: Remove empty ASN.1 dissector headers
commits_data.message:
Remove empty ASN.1 dissector headers

A number of ASN.1 dissectors have empty headers that don't export
anything and have the exports commented out (as a placeholder, perhaps.)
Remove them.
